title: The International
description: An Interpol agent (Clive Owen) and a New York prosecutor (Naomi Watts) join forces to shut down a powerful bank's funding of terrorism.

title: Devil in a Blue Dress
description: A mortgage and no job force a black war hero (Denzel Washington) to seek a mystery lady (Jennifer Beals) for a shady guy (Tom Sizemore) in 1948 Los Angeles.

title: Tortured
description: A mobster orders an undercover FBI agent (Cole Hauser) to torture an accountant (Laurence Fishburne).

title: Lake Placid 2
description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
description: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: Chances Are
description: A reincarnated man (Robert Downey Jr.) returns 23 years later to his wife (Cybill Shepherd), their daughter and his former best friend (Ryan O'Neal).

title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: Lost & Found
description: To rebuild their family fortune, teenage brothers hunt for treasure while spending the summer on a remote island.

title: Alpha
description: Left for dead, a Cro-Magnon teen forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, the boy and the wolf must now trek through a harsh landscape to make it home before winter.

title: Radio Flyer
description: Two boys (Elijah Wood, Joseph Mazzello) dream up a red-wagon flying machine to escape from their drunken and abusive stepfather (Adam Baldwin).

title: Philadelphia
description: Fired by his firm, a lawyer (Tom Hanks) with AIDS fights back in court with help from his lawyer (Denzel Washington).

title: Legends of the Fall
description: A retired cavalry officer (Anthony Hopkins) and his sons (Brad Pitt, Aidan Quinn) live on a pre-World War I Montana cattle ranch.

title: Sunset
description: Tom Mix (Bruce Willis) and Wyatt Earp (James Garner) solve a murder mystery at the Academy Awards in 1929 Hollywood.

title: Stealing Harvard
description: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.

title: A Fine Mess
description: Two small-timers (Ted Danson, Howie Mandel) win a fixed horse race, buy an antique piano and run from gangsters.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Suspect
description: A Washington lobbyist (Dennis Quaid) on jury duty helps a public defender (Cher) save a deaf-mute vagrant (Liam Neeson) accused of murder.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: Devil in a Blue Dress
description: A mortgage and no job force a black war hero (Denzel Washington) to seek a mystery lady (Jennifer Beals) for a shady guy (Tom Sizemore) in 1948 Los Angeles.

title: Money Train
description: A New York transit officer (Woody Harrelson) fights subway crime with his foster brother (Wesley Snipes) and dreams of robbing the train carrying system revenue.

title: The Interview
description: When a tabloid-TV host (James Franco) and producer (Seth Rogen) land an interview with Kim Jong-un, the CIA recruits the pair to assassinate the North Korean dictator instead.
Students (Jim Sturgess, Kate Bosworth) from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology become experts at card-counting and use the skill to win big at Las Vegas casinos.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.

title: Crazy in Alabama
description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Peggy Sue Got Married
description: A 1985 housewife (Kathleen Turner) passes out at her high-school reunion and wakes up in 1960, in school with her husband-to-be (Nicolas Cage).

title: Bewitched
description: An actual witch (Nicole Kidman) and a neurotic movie star (Will Ferrell) land the lead roles in a television remake of the 1960s sitcom.

title: Big Fish
description: A young journalist (Billy Crudup) searches for the truth behind the tall tales told by his ailing father (Albert Finney).

title: Silverado
description: Old West drifters Jake (Kevin Costner), Emmett (Scott Glenn), Mal and Paden (Kevin Kline) shoot it out with a crooked sheriff and clan.
Students (Jim Sturgess, Kate Bosworth) from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology become experts at card-counting and use the skill to win big at Las Vegas casinos.

title: Total Recall
description: A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.

title: The Cave
description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

title: The International
description: An Interpol agent (Clive Owen) and a New York prosecutor (Naomi Watts) join forces to shut down a powerful bank's funding of terrorism.

title: Final Descent
description: A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision.

title: Final Run
description: A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital.

title: The Waterdance
description: Paralyzed by a hiking accident, a young writer (Eric Stoltz) struggles to adjust among other men in a hospital ward.

title: 7 Seconds
description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.
